in_sanskrit.name: पवनकुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the son of the god of wind

in_marathi.name: Pawankumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pawankumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pawan refers to the wind god, and Kumar means young or prince. Pawankumar can be translated as the 'Lord of the Forest' or 'Young Prince of the Wind'.

in_bengali.name: Pawankumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Forest
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pawankumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Pawan refers to the wind god, and Kumar means young or prince. Pawankumar can be translated as the 'Lord of the Forest' or 'Young Prince of the Wind'.
